market.question: Will the highest temperature in Warsaw be 26°C on May 3?

assessment.reasoning: Warsaw May 2026 monthly forecast shows daily highs ranging 16-27°C; first-third-of-May average ~18°C. The 26°C bucket is on the warm tail of climatology but not impossible. Without a specific May 3 ECMWF/IMGW point forecast for Warsaw Chopin, I keep this around 15-20%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a warm air mass spikes Warsaw to mid-20s on May 3 specifically.
